items.question: Which UAE ministry oversees the National Scholarship Programme for study abroad?
items.gold: The Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MoHESR) oversees the National Scholarship Programme for study abroad.
items.fact: MoHESR oversees the National Scholarship Programme for study abroad.

items.question: Does the UAE Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research regulate the licensing of private higher education institutions?
items.gold: Yes, the ministry regulates the licensing of public and private institutions.
items.fact: MoHESR regulates licensing of public and private institutions.
